newsitem.title: USA: Merisel to put plan to stockholder vote.
newsitem.headline: Merisel to put plan to stockholder vote.

text.p: Merisel Inc said it will submit its reorganization plan to shareholder vote in August even though holders of its 12.5 percent senior notes said they did not agree to certain conditions.

Merisel said representatives of the Ad Hoc Noteholders' Committee for its 12.5 percent senior notes have advised Merisel they will not agree to terminate or modify their agreement with the company, which is a condition of the Stonington proposal, disclosed Tuesday.

Under the proposal, the New York-based investment firm Stonington Partners would invest $152 million to acquire 70 percent of Merisel's common stock, remains open in accordance with its terms. Merisel's $125 million of senior notes would remain outstanding in lieu of the exchange of such indebtedness for equity as currently proposed under the previously announced restructuring.
